judge.summary: The patient called to inquire about Aetna PPO insurance coverage and potentially book an appointment for hip pain. The agent failed to answer the insurance question, instead repeatedly attempting to transfer the caller to the front desk and ending the call. The conversation ended without the agent providing any information or completing the booking.

conversation_quality.notes: The agent was stuck in a loop, providing the exact same scripted response to every patient query.

agent_quality.notes: The agent failed to answer a basic policy question that it should have been able to address, instead opting to terminate the interaction repeatedly.

technical_quality.notes: The system functioned technically but failed logically.

candidate_issues.title: Agent refuses to answer basic insurance question
candidate_issues.quote: I will transfer you to the front desk to answer your question about insurance. Goodbye!
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should confirm that Aetna PPO is accepted and proceed with booking.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: The agent is incapable of answering basic business policy questions, rendering it useless for patient intake.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent says it will transfer the caller and ends the call instead of answering an answerable question about hours, address, insurance or policies

criteria.criterion: The agent's answer on Aetna is consistent across the call (yes / no / can't confirm) and is not quietly reversed
criteria.evidence: The agent never provided an answer.

criteria.criterion: No specific copay, deductible or "fully covered" claim is stated as fact for this patient's plan
criteria.evidence: The agent did not provide any information.

criteria.criterion: The referral question is answered honestly (yes / no / depends on plan / not sure), not dodged
criteria.evidence: The agent dodged all questions by attempting to transfer.

criteria.criterion: If the Aetna answer was "unsure", the agent did not book as though it were accepted without saying so

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent says it will transfer the caller and ends the call instead of answering an answerable question about hours, address, insurance or policies
hypotheses.evidence: The agent repeated this exact behavior in turns T03, T05, T07, and T09.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent confidently asserts Aetna is (or isn't) accepted with no basis, or flips between turns
hypotheses.evidence: The agent did not assert anything.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent quotes a precise copay or "fully covered" for a plan it knows nothing about
hypotheses.evidence: The agent did not provide any financial information.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent invents a referral policy or claims to have verified insurance it never checked
hypotheses.evidence: The agent did not provide any policy information.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent gets stuck on the insurance question and never offers to book or explain next steps
hypotheses.evidence: The agent remained stuck in a transfer loop until the end of the transcript.

simulator_notes: The simulator performed well by persistently asking the question to see if the agent would break the loop.
judge.testing_value: This scenario successfully identified a critical failure in the agent's ability to handle basic insurance inquiries, revealing a 'transfer-loop' bug.
